ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Use the 15-dimensional basis of marker monomials of total degree at most two in E0, E1, H0, and H1, with endpoint-polynomial coefficients over the frozen base field.

ambiguity_resolutions.basis: The compiler exists to replace P1509's cubic aggregate opening path, so allowing those objects during construction would assume the missing algorithm.
